question: Which sacred sites are preeminent in the Dvāpara and Kali ages?
premises: Kurukṣetraṃ names the preeminent site in Dvāpara.
Kalau yuge locates the second age.
Aśvatīrthaṃ names the preeminent site in Kali.
inference: Kurukṣetra is preeminent in the Dvāpara age and Aśvatīrtha in the Kali age.
plain_english: In the Dvāpara age it is Kurukṣetra, and in the Kali age it is Aśvatīrtha.
